# NFL Daily — 2026-10-23 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) is questionable for Sunday vs. the Bengals; swelling has eased and it's now a pain-tolerance question. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50260001/ravens-lamar-jackson-high-ankle-sprain-unsure-play)
- Bears TE Cole Kmet is out for the season with a serious knee injury and is headed to IR. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50259989/bears-te-cole-kmet-season-knee-injury-vs-pats) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2113693639494770719)
- Jaguars LT Anton Harrison is out for the season after a torn ACL was discovered during surgery. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/anton-harrison-injury-news-jaguars-offensive-tackles)
- Rams WR Puka Nacua (calf) is questionable for Sunday vs. the Raiders after sitting out Friday's practice. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50259748/rams-wr-puka-nacua-questionable-vs-raiders-calf-injury)
- Colts QB Anthony Richardson Sr. faces a misdemeanor marijuana possession charge from an Oct. 12 traffic stop. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50257962/colts-qb-anthony-richardson-sr-charged-marijuana-possession)
- Hall of Famer Marshall Faulk revealed he has been diagnosed with Parkinson's disease. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50253673/marshall-faulk-hall-famer-southern-coach-parkinsons)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-10-23 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- QB Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) is questionable for Sunday vs. the Bengals; he says the swelling has eased and it's now a question of pain tolerance, not needing to be 100%. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-ankle-injury-explains-whats-going-on-ravens-bengals) — also [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2113691198343020820)
- Ravens' injury report for Sunday vs. Bengals: OLB Tavius Robinson (pectoral), the team's sack leader, is out for the season; S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) is also out; CB T.J. Tampa (knee) is doubtful; and DL Broderick Washington (ankle) joins Jackson as questionable. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2113716198202343742)

# Rivals — 2026-10-23 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Steelers edge rusher T.J. Watt (calf) is expected to play Sunday in Paris against the Saints, per coach Mike McCarthy. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/10/mike-mccarthy-gives-huge-update-on-steelers-star-tj-watt-after-going-down-with-injury.html)
- Steelers DT Sebastian Joseph-Day was placed on injured reserve with a triceps injury. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/10/pittsburgh-steelers-lose-key-defensive-tackle-to-triceps-injury.html)
- Steelers S DeShon Elliott (knee) could return Sunday against the Saints, a year removed from a serious knee injury. [Post-Gazette](https://www.post-gazette.com/sports/steelers/2026/10/23/will-deshon-elliott-play-sunday/stories/202610230028)
- Steelers canceled Saturday's Paris fan event amid escalating civil unrest; the NFL says Sunday's game against the Saints will proceed as planned. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/10/why-the-steelers-suddenly-cancelled-their-paris-fan-event-just-one-day-before-it-was-supposed-to-happen.html)
- Bills S Sam Franklin Jr.'s one-game suspension for an alleged spitting incident was reduced to a $14,926 fine on appeal. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2113667103719063757)
- Chiefs WR Rashee Rice (hamstring) is out for Sunday's game vs. the Seahawks, per coach Andy Reid. [Nate Taylor](https://x.com/ByNateTaylor/status/2113694260469862561)
- Browns RBs Quinshon Judkins (ankle) and Dylan Sampson (knee) are both trending to play Sunday vs. the Titans. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50259999/browns-rbs-quinshon-judkins-dylan-sampson-expected-play)
